source_claim: Yomiuri TV's official Inuyasha episode guide identifies a large shindamachuu (死魂虫) as a creature sent by Naraku in the original-series story and describes Kagome and the group's encounter with it.
notes: The official episode page explicitly names the creature and places its appearance in an Inuyasha episode. It is treated as a distinct entity; this does not infer that it is Shippou.
